attacks.name: Feelin' Fine
attacks.text: Draw a card.

sv3-1.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

attacks.name: Inviting Scent
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

sv3-2.flavorText: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Powerful Dance
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.

sv3-3.flavorText: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

sv3-4.flavorText: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

attacks.name: Berry Scent
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

sv3-5.flavorText: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

sv3-6.flavorText: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

attacks.name: Panic-Prompting Pattern
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

sv3-7.flavorText: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

attacks.name: Share
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

sv3-8.flavorText: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

attacks.name: Enticing Pattern
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Grass Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv3-9.flavorText: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

attacks.name: Dangerous Spores
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

sv3-10.flavorText: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss's caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

sv3-11.flavorText: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

abilities.name: Forest Miasma
abilities.text: During Pokémon Checkup, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

sv3-12.flavorText: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

sv3-13.flavorText: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

attacks.name: Shoot Through
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

sv3-14.flavorText: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

attacks.name: Hunting Arrow
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Total Freedom
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. If this Pokémon is on the Bench, switch it with your Active Pokémon. Or, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, switch it with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv3-16.flavorText: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

attacks.name: Aromatherapy
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

sv3-17.flavorText: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

attacks.name: Queenly Heel
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, Pokémon can't be played from your opponent's hand to evolve the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spinning Kick
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

sv3-18.flavorText: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

sv3-19.flavorText: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

attacks.name: Sunny Wind
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

sv3-20.flavorText: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

attacks.name: Healing Fruit
attacks.text: Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

sv3-21.flavorText: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

attacks.name: Colony Rush
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any Grass Energy attached.

abilities.name: Protective Mycelium
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv3-23.flavorText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

attacks.name: Double Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

sv3-24.flavorText: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

attacks.name: Spicy Headbutt
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Grass and Fire type.

sv3-25.flavorText: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv3-26.flavorText: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

sv3-27.flavorText: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

sv3-28.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

attacks.name: Nine-Tailed Dance
attacks.text: Put 9 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

sv3-29.flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

attacks.name: Blaze Ball
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Pressure
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

sv3-30.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

attacks.name: Hot Magma
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

sv3-31.flavorText: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Discard the top card of each player's deck. This attack does 100 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.

sv3-32.flavorText: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Victory Flame
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

sv3-34.flavorText: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

attacks.name: Damage Counterpunch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

sv3-35.flavorText: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Firebreathing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

sv3-36.flavorText: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

attacks.name: Alluring Fireball
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 30 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

sv3-37.flavorText: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

attacks.name: Combustion Chain
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

sv3-38.flavorText: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—or so it's said.

attacks.name: Energy Burner
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

sv3-39.flavorText: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv3-40.flavorText: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

attacks.name: Flame Cloak
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

sv3-41.flavorText: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

attacks.name: Scalding Block
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

sv3-43.flavorText: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

abilities.name: Scorching Armor
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Burned.

sv3-44.flavorText: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

attacks.name: Hail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

sv3-45.flavorText: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

sv3-46.flavorText: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

sv3-47.flavorText: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

sv3-48.flavorText: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

attacks.name: Swirling Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all attached cards into your opponent's hand.

sv3-49.flavorText: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

attacks.name: Screw Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

sv3-50.flavorText: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

sv3-51.flavorText: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

attacks.name: Echoed Voice
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Echoed Voice attack does 100 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

abilities.name: Quaking Zone
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon cost Colorless more.

sv3-52.flavorText: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

sv3-53.flavorText: Many of this species can be found along the shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks dangling snot, there's a chance it is sick.

attacks.name: Frost Purge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

sv3-54.flavorText: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

attacks.name: First Freeze
attacks.text: If you go second and it's your first turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

sv3-55.flavorText: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

attacks.name: Try Bouncing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

sv3-56.flavorText: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

sv3-57.flavorText: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 600 metres in a minute's time.

sv3-58.flavorText: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

attacks.name: Entwining Entrapment
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

sv3-59.flavorText: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

attacks.name: Valiant Evolution
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv3-60.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

sv3-61.flavorText: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Justice Kick
attacks.text: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing.

sv3-62.flavorText: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

sv3-63.flavorText: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

sv3-64.flavorText: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

attacks.name: Magnetic Repulsion
attacks.text: You may switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

sv3-65.flavorText: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

attacks.name: Mountain Hurl
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Lightning Rampage
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 100 more damage.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

sv3-67.flavorText: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

attacks.name: Volt Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

sv3-68.flavorText: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

attacks.name: Suction Shock
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. If you do, this attack does 60 damage to the new Active Pokémon, and then flip a coin. If heads, that Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

sv3-69.flavorText: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

attacks.name: Gigantic Bolt
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 90 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Adverse Weather
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

sv3-70.flavorText: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

attacks.name: Slight Intrusion
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv3-71.flavorText: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Loud Mix
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each different type of Pokémon on your Bench.

sv3-72.flavorText: Many youths admire the way this Pokémon listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no matter what opponent it faces.

attacks.name: Levin Strike
attacks.text: Discard 2 Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 220 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Energize
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

sv3-74.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv3-75.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

attacks.name: Shake and Discharge
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

sv3-76.flavorText: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

attacks.name: Electrobullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

sv3-77.flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

attacks.name: Thunderous Edge
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Insulator
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Lightning Pokémon.

sv3-78.flavorText: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

attacks.name: Rapid Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Techno Turbo
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Grasping Draw
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.

sv3-80.flavorText: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

attacks.name: Slap Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

sv3-81.flavorText: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

attacks.name: Wondrous Moon
attacks.text: You may move any amount of Psychic Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

abilities.name: Lunar Zone
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon that have Psychic Energy attached have no Retreat Cost.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Whiny Voice
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

sv3-83.flavorText: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.

attacks.name: Shared Peace
attacks.text: Each player draws 3 cards.

sv3-84.flavorText: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

attacks.name: Power Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Precious Gift
abilities.text: Once at the end of your turn (after your attack), you may use this Ability. Draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand.

sv3-85.flavorText: Known as a bringer of blessings, it's been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

attacks.name: Psychic Assault
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

sv3-86.flavorText: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent's next move.

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

sv3-87.flavorText: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

sv3-88.flavorText: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

attacks.name: Mischievous Crunch
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

sv3-89.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

sv3-90.flavorText: Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on its head amplifies its psychic powers.

attacks.name: Powerful Steps
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv3-91.flavorText: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

abilities.name: New Moon
abilities.text: If you have Solrock in play, prevent all effects of any Stadium done to your Pokémon in play.

sv3-92.flavorText: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

sv3-93.flavorText: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

sv3-94.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

attacks.name: Kaboom Doll
attacks.text: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10. If you placed any damage counters in this way, this attack also does 120 damage to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

sv3-95.flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

attacks.name: Healing Pheromone
attacks.text: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Phantom Queen
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Cold Tea
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

sv3-97.flavorText: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

attacks.name: Antique Collecting
attacks.text: Put up to 2 in any combination of Item cards and Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Pour Tea
attacks.text: Put 5 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

sv3-98.flavorText: The tea that composes Polteageist's body has a distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much, however, can be fatal.

sv3-99.flavorText: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

sv3-100.flavorText: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Two Four-ocious
attacks.text: If your opponent has exactly 2 or 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 120 more damage.

sv3-101.flavorText: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Last Respects
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each Psychic Pokémon in your discard pile.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hole-Diggin' Noggin
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

sv3-103.flavorText: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

sv3-104.flavorText: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

sv3-105.flavorText: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

attacks.name: Blasting Tackle
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

sv3-106.flavorText: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

attacks.name: Iron Collecting
attacks.text: Put up to 2 Basic Metal Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

sv3-107.flavorText: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

sv3-108.flavorText: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

attacks.name: Raging and Rocking
attacks.text: For each Fighting Energy attached to this Pokémon, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

sv3-111.flavorText: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.

sv3-112.flavorText: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

attacks.name: Knocking Hammer

sv3-113.flavorText: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

sv3-114.flavorText: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.

attacks.name: Knuckle Impact

sv3-115.flavorText: The detached pincers of these Pokémon are delicious. Some Trainers bring Lechonk into the mountains just to search for them.

sv3-116.flavorText: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

attacks.name: Finishing Fang

sv3-117.flavorText: This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer if it dislikes the orders it was given.

sv3-118.flavorText: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

attacks.name: Double Whip

attacks.name: Fluffy Guard

sv3-170.flavorText: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won't forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.

sv3-171.flavorText: The black fur that covers this Pokémon's body is dense and springy. Even sharp fangs bounce right off.

attacks.name: Perfume Press

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. During this turn, your Pokémon can't attack. (This includes Pokémon that come into play this turn.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

Your opponent reveals their hand, and you choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck. If you put a card on the bottom of your opponent's deck in this way, your opponent may draw a card.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
Move up to 2 Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.
Draw 3 cards. Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

attacks.name: Scalding Block
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't attack.

rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Burning Darkness
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

abilities.name: Infernal Reign
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 Basic Fire Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

abilities.name: Tune-Up
abilities.text: This Pokémon may have up to 4 Pokémon Tools attached to it. If it loses this Ability, discard Pokémon Tools from it until only 1 remains.

Once during each player's turn, that player may search their deck for a Basic Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box and put it onto their Bench. Then, that player shuffles their deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.
